plan: With a private value of $9, I want to maximize potential profit. In Stage 2's descending clock mechanism, I'll aim to claim the item just above my value. Since my value is $9, I'll bid strategically to win if the clock drops to near my value. A bid around $9.50 seems optimal - high enough to potentially win, but not so high that I lose money if I acquire the item. This balances winning probability with profit margin.

My private value is $40. In Stage 2, I want to claim the item when the clock price reaches my sealed bid. To maximize profit, I want to bid just low enough to win but not overpay. Since my value is $40, I'll bid strategically to capture most of the potential profit. I'll bid $39, which allows me to win at a low price and still gain roughly $1 in profit if I win. This leaves room for strategic flexibility.

In this single-round sealed bid auction, my value is $32. The optimal strategy is to bid strategically to maximize expected profit. Since the first bidder to claim at their sealed bid wins, I want to bid just low enough to win if my value justifies it. Given the descending clock mechanism, I'll bid close to my value but slightly below to create a profit margin.
